You can use 炸牛肉角 to talk about food choices when ordering in a restaurant.
炸牛肉角 can be the subject or object of a sentence, depending on what you want to say about it.
When describing 炸牛肉角, you might add adjectives to express how yummy or crispy it is.
炸牛肉角 can appear in questions, for example, asking if someone likes eating it.
